# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Stacy is a bright, young woman with fair, curly hair and fascinating eyes. She dresses beautifully and wears garments with large sleeve puffs.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is a sympathetic, ladylike woman with a sweet voice who easily wins the affection of her pupils and brings out their best qualities. She is an encouraging, broadminded, and tactful teacher who inspires her students to explore and think for themselves. She also values physical culture and nature study, frequently taking her classes on outdoor field trips.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)_

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired by the school trustees as the first female teacher in Avonlea. She quickly gained the devotion of her pupils, including Anne Shirley, through her sympathetic nature and innovative teaching methods, such as nature study field trips and physical culture exercises. When the scholars wished to raise money for a school flag, Miss Stacy organized a Christmas Night concert in the hall. After her first year, she declined a position in her home district to remain at Avonlea and guide her advanced students through the Entrance examinations for Queen's Academy, offering them extra lessons after school. Following the successful completion of the term and the passing of her Queen's Class pupils, Miss Stacy left Avonlea. She eventually married and moved to California.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v4 c3 P10](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0010)_
